title: Minimum Absolute Difference Between Two Values
summary: Given an array containing 0, 1 and 2, find the smallest absolute index difference between an occurrence of 1 and an occurrence of 2. Return -1 if no such pair exists.
officialConstraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 100; every entry is an integer in [0, 2].
semanticPitfalls: Zeros are valid input but never endpoints of a valid pair.
The minimized quantity is the index difference, not the value difference.
Either missing endpoint value means return -1.
The current visualization cap of 20 is not the official maximum length of 100.
implementationReview: At cff33e863 the parser rejects zeros, the default preset contains 3, and pair frames have activeLine 0. This sourced note does not certify the implementation. See docs/reviews/2026-11-02-latest-visualization-review.md.
